summary: 52-year-old out-of-state male bow hunter rolled his ATV around 5 p.m. Saturday (2013-09-14) in the Routt County woods; delayed-onset upper back pain set in and his hunting companion called for help; six Routt County Search and Rescue volunteers rode about 10 miles into the woods Monday evening (2013-09-16) to bring him out; incident commander Kristia Check-Hill.
